## Research objective

Fine-tune the target language model to improve financial qa in the finance domain. The downstream requirement is: answer chinese financial examination questions requiring quantitative and domain reasoning.

## Available starting point

The reported experiment starts from Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct and draws raw material from `financeiq` in the shared repository. Inspect the data, construct suitable input/output training records, and create a LLaMA-Factory configuration. The source interface expects Alpaca-style instruction, input, and output fields.

## Experiment loop

Check generated data and configuration before launching the full training job. Train a candidate, inspect validation results and failure cases, and revise the data or training approach within the remaining budget. Use validation feedback for iteration; the test split is reserved for final reporting.

## Evaluation and budget

The task reports Accuracy. The paper uses one NVIDIA B200 and a twelve-hour end-to-end limit, including preparation, training, evaluation, and agent interaction. These are suite-level experimental settings, not a separate per-task GPU declaration.

This is a task-specific summary of the paper and released interface, not a verbatim original agent prompt.

## Official task-specific input description

FinanceIQ tests financial domain knowledge through multiple-choice questions (A/B/C/D). Covers 10 Chinese financial certification exams: CPA (注册会计师), banking qualification, securities qualification, fund qualification, futures qualification, insurance qualification (CICE), tax advisor, economist, financial planner, and actuary. Uses LLM Judge for evaluation with 5-shot in-context learning. Evaluation metric: accuracy.

Source: [RD-Agent scenario registry](https://github.com/microsoft/RD-Agent/blob/484776c211e4fbbeef03e0ec00d6bbee7362a4f4/rdagent/app/finetune/llm/job/scenarios.json), MIT licensed. This is the complete registry description, alongside the summarized research protocol above.
